lines.s: Did you get a present for your sister?
lines.zh: 你買到送你妹妹的禮物了嗎？
lines.en: Did you get a present for your sister?

lines.s: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.
lines.zh: 買了。本來想買書給她，可是她書太多了。後來看到一條很漂亮的圍巾，但太貴了，所以最後買了一條項鍊。
lines.en: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.

q.s: What did the boy buy for his sister?
q.en: What did the boy buy for his sister?

explain.zh: 書她太多、圍巾太貴，「最後買了一條項鍊」。
explain.en: Too many books, the scarf too expensive: a necklace in the end.

lines.s: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?
lines.zh: 你要搭計程車去機場嗎？
lines.en: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?

lines.s: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.
lines.zh: 不要，太貴了。我搭火車，比公車快。
lines.en: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.

q.s: How will the woman get to the airport?
q.en: How will the woman get to the airport?

explain.zh: 計程車太貴，「我搭火車，比公車快」。
explain.en: Taxis are too expensive; the train is quicker than the bus.

lines.s: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?
lines.zh: 我們星期六去海邊好嗎？
lines.en: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?

lines.s: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.
lines.zh: 氣象預報說早上會下雨，但整個下午都是晴天。
lines.en: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.

lines.s: Great — let's go after lunch, then.
lines.zh: 太好了，那我們吃完午飯再去。
lines.en: Great — let's go after lunch, then.

q.s: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?
q.zh: 星期六下午天氣會怎麼樣？
q.en: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?

explain.zh: 早上下雨，「整個下午都是晴天」。
explain.en: Rain in the morning, sunny all afternoon.

lines.s: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.
lines.zh: 你有看到我的眼鏡嗎？我以為放在包包裡。
lines.en: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.

lines.s: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.
lines.zh: 在廚房的桌子上，報紙旁邊。
lines.en: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.

q.s: Where are the man's glasses?
q.en: Where are the man's glasses?

explain.zh: 他以為在包包裡，但其實「在廚房的桌子上」。
explain.en: He thought in his bag, but they are on the kitchen table.

lines.s: Did you play tennis at the weekend?
lines.zh: 你週末有去打網球嗎？
lines.en: Did you play tennis at the weekend?

lines.s: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.
lines.zh: 沒有，風太大了，所以我們改去游泳。下週末我們要去聽演唱會。
lines.en: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.

q.s: What did the girl do at the weekend?
q.en: What did the girl do at the weekend?

explain.zh: 風太大沒打網球，「改去游泳」；演唱會是下週末。
explain.en: Too windy for tennis, so swimming; the concert is next weekend.

lines.s: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.
lines.zh: 大家好。我要跟大家說下個月去科學博物館的校外教學。我們五月十四日星期四出發——不是我之前說的星期五。遊覽車八點半從學校出發，所以請在八點二十分以前到停車場。這次活動十二英鎊，包含在博物館咖啡廳的午餐。要帶筆記本和一支筆，因為要寫學習單。還有別忘了穿好走的鞋子，我們會走很多路。有問題請寄電子郵件給我。我是格林老師，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N。
lines.en: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.

ask.zh: 出發日期：＿＿ 5 月 14 日

explain.zh: 「五月十四日星期四——不是我之前說的星期五」。
「遊覽車八點半從學校出發」；八點二十分是要到停車場的時間。
explain.en: It leaves at 8.30; be there by 8.20.

explain.zh: 「這次活動十二英鎊」。
「要帶筆記本和一支筆」。
「我是格林老師，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N」。

lines.s: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?
lines.zh: 嗨，艾瑪！新工作怎麼樣？
lines.en: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?

lines.s: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.
lines.zh: 很好，謝謝。我在電影院工作三個星期了。
lines.en: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.

lines.s: What do you do there?
lines.zh: 你在那裡做什麼？
lines.en: What do you do there?

lines.s: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.
lines.zh: 大部分時間在賣票，有時候也在咖啡吧幫忙做爆米花和飲料。
lines.en: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.

lines.s: Do you get to watch the films for free?
lines.zh: 你可以免費看電影嗎？
lines.en: Do you get to watch the films for free?

lines.s: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!
lines.zh: 可以，星期一員工想看哪部都可以。上週我看了新的太空片，超好看，但滿長的，將近三個小時！
lines.en: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!

lines.s: What are your hours like?
lines.zh: 你的上班時間怎麼樣？
lines.en: What are your hours like?

lines.s: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.
lines.zh: 星期五和星期六晚上，六點到十一點。我在存錢，暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙。
lines.en: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.

ask.s: How long has Emma worked at the cinema?
ask.zh: 艾瑪在電影院工作多久了？
ask.en: How long has Emma worked at the cinema?

explain.zh: 「我在電影院工作三個星期了」。

ask.s: What does Emma do most of the time?
ask.zh: 艾瑪大部分時間做什麼？
ask.en: What does Emma do most of the time?

explain.zh: 「大部分時間在賣票」，做爆米花只是有時候。

ask.s: When can staff see films for free?
ask.zh: 員工什麼時候可以免費看電影？
ask.en: When can staff see films for free?

explain.zh: 「星期一員工想看哪部都可以」。

ask.s: What did Emma think of the space film?
ask.zh: 艾瑪覺得那部太空片怎麼樣？
ask.en: What did Emma think of the space film?

explain.zh: 「超好看」（brilliant），而且很長，不是太短。
「暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙」：為了旅行。

lines.s: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士談一家餐廳。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.

lines.s: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.
lines.zh: 羅莎餐廳的菜很好吃，服務生也很親切。唯一的問題是不太好找，在車站後面的一條小街上。
lines.en: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.

ask.s: What does the woman say about the restaurant?
ask.en: What does the woman say about the restaurant?

explain.zh: 「唯一的問題是不太好找」；服務生很親切，地點在車站後面。
explain.en: Hard to find; friendly waiters; behind the station.

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩和媽媽說話。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.

lines.s: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.
lines.zh: 媽，可以借你的筆電嗎？我的壞了，今晚要把歷史作業做完。
lines.en: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.

lines.s: OK, but I need it back by nine.
lines.zh: 好，但九點前要還我。
lines.en: OK, but I need it back by nine.

ask.s: Why does the boy want the laptop?
ask.en: Why does the boy want the laptop?

explain.zh: 「今晚要把歷史作業做完」。

lines.s: You will hear a man leaving a message.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士留言。
lines.en: You will hear a man leaving a message.

lines.s: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?
lines.zh: 露西，我是丹。我沒辦法四點在咖啡店跟你見面，火車誤點了。改成五點好嗎？地點一樣。
lines.en: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?

ask.s: What does Dan want to change?
ask.en: What does Dan want to change?

explain.zh: 四點改成五點，「地點一樣」：改的是時間。
explain.en: Four to five, same place: the time.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a party.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一個派對。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a party.

lines.s: Are you going to Tom's party?
lines.zh: 你要去湯姆的派對嗎？
lines.en: Are you going to Tom's party?

lines.s: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.
lines.zh: 很想去，可是那個週末我爺爺奶奶要來，所以得待在家。
lines.en: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.

ask.s: Why can't the boy go to the party?
ask.zh: 男孩為什麼不能去派對？
ask.en: Why can't the boy go to the party?

options.t: He has to see his family.

explain.zh: 「爺爺奶奶要來，所以得待在家」。

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她的新嗜好。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.

lines.s: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.
lines.zh: 我去年開始拍照，大多拍動物，尤其是鳥。下個月我要參加比賽。
lines.en: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.

ask.s: What does the girl usually take photos of?
ask.en: What does the girl usually take photos of?

explain.zh: 「大多拍動物，尤其是鳥」。

lines.s: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?
lines.zh: 那麼，星期天的野餐大家要帶什麼？
lines.en: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?

lines.s: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.
lines.zh: 安娜說她要烤蛋糕，她很會烤。
lines.en: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.

lines.s: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.
lines.zh: 太好了。班呢？他通常帶飲料。
lines.en: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.

lines.s: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.
lines.zh: 這次不是。他星期六要去市場，所以會買水果。
lines.en: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.

lines.s: OK. And Chloe?
lines.zh: 好。克蘿伊呢？
lines.en: OK. And Chloe?

lines.s: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.
lines.zh: 克蘿伊本來想帶冰淇淋，可是會融化，所以改做一大盤沙拉。
lines.en: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.

lines.s: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?
lines.zh: 好主意。那大衛帶飲料嗎？
lines.en: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?

lines.s: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.
lines.zh: 對，檸檬汽水和水。艾拉說她要幫大家做三明治。
lines.en: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.

lines.s: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.
lines.zh: 太好了，那我帶麵包和起司。
lines.en: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.

explain.zh: 「安娜說她要烤蛋糕」。
班通常帶飲料，「這次不是」，他會買水果。
冰淇淋會融化，「改做一大盤沙拉」。
大衛帶「檸檬汽水和水」。
「艾拉說她要幫大家做三明治」；麵包和起司是女的要帶的。
explain.en: Sandwiches; the bread and cheese are the woman's.

lines.s: What did you have for lunch at the new café?
lines.zh: 你在新開的咖啡館午餐吃了什麼？
lines.en: What did you have for lunch at the new café?

lines.s: I wanted a sandwich, but they'd sold them all. The salads looked nice, but I was really hungry, so I had a pizza.
lines.zh: 我想吃三明治，可是賣完了。沙拉看起來不錯，但我實在太餓了，所以吃了披薩。
lines.en: I wanted a sandwich, but they'd sold them all. The salads looked nice, but I was really hungry, so I had a pizza.

q.s: What did the man have for lunch?
q.en: What did the man have for lunch?

explain.zh: 三明治賣完、沙拉不夠飽，「所以吃了披薩」。
explain.en: Sandwiches sold out, too hungry for salad: a pizza.

lines.s: Shall we go to the cinema this afternoon?
lines.zh: 我們今天下午去看電影好嗎？
lines.en: Shall we go to the cinema this afternoon?

lines.s: It's too nice to sit inside. Let's take a picnic to the park. We can go swimming tomorrow if it's hot.
lines.zh: 天氣這麼好，待在室內太可惜了。我們帶野餐去公園吧。如果明天很熱，再去游泳。
lines.en: It's too nice to sit inside. Let's take a picnic to the park. We can go swimming tomorrow if it's hot.

q.s: Where will they go this afternoon?
q.zh: 他們今天下午會去哪裡？
q.en: Where will they go this afternoon?

explain.zh: 「我們帶野餐去公園吧」；游泳是明天。
explain.en: A picnic in the park; swimming is tomorrow.

lines.s: Has your brother got a pet?
lines.zh: 你哥哥有養寵物嗎？
lines.en: Has your brother got a pet?

lines.s: He's always wanted a dog, but our flat is too small. He's got a cat now — and he wants a rabbit next!
lines.zh: 他一直想養狗，可是我們家公寓太小。他現在養了一隻貓，下一個還想養兔子！
lines.en: He's always wanted a dog, but our flat is too small. He's got a cat now — and he wants a rabbit next!

q.s: What pet has the boy's brother got?
q.zh: 男孩的哥哥養了什麼寵物？
q.en: What pet has the boy's brother got?

explain.zh: 「他現在養了一隻貓」；狗是想養但不行，兔子是以後。
explain.en: A cat now; the dog and rabbit are only wishes.

lines.s: Are you still having piano lessons?
lines.zh: 你還在上鋼琴課嗎？
lines.en: Are you still having piano lessons?

lines.s: No, I stopped last year. I play the violin now. My sister plays the guitar, so sometimes we play together.
lines.zh: 沒有，去年停了。我現在拉小提琴。我姊姊彈吉他，所以有時候我們一起演奏。
lines.en: No, I stopped last year. I play the violin now. My sister plays the guitar, so sometimes we play together.

q.s: What instrument does the girl play now?
q.zh: 女孩現在演奏什麼樂器？
q.en: What instrument does the girl play now?

explain.zh: 鋼琴去年停了，「我現在拉小提琴」；吉他是姊姊的。
explain.en: She plays the violin now; the guitar is her sister's.

lines.s: How do you get to school? By bike?
lines.zh: 你怎麼去上學？騎腳踏車嗎？
lines.en: How do you get to school? By bike?

lines.s: I used to, but someone stole my bike. Dad drives past the school, but he leaves too early, so I walk now.
lines.zh: 以前是，可是我的腳踏車被偷了。爸爸開車會經過學校，但他出門太早，所以我現在走路。
lines.en: I used to, but someone stole my bike. Dad drives past the school, but he leaves too early, so I walk now.

q.s: How does the boy get to school now?
q.en: How does the boy get to school now?

explain.zh: 腳踏車被偷、爸爸太早出門，「所以我現在走路」。
explain.en: His bike was stolen and Dad leaves too early: he walks.

lines.s: Hi, everyone. I'm going to give you some information about the summer sports camp. The camp starts on Monday the third of August and lasts for two weeks. It's at Hillside School — not at the sports centre like last year. Every day starts at nine o'clock and finishes at four. You can choose from football, tennis and basketball. The cost is forty-five pounds a week. Please bring a packed lunch, because there's no café. And remember to bring a water bottle — it gets very hot. To book a place, phone Mr Dixon — that's D-I-X-O-N.
lines.zh: 大家好。我來說明暑期運動營的資訊。營隊八月三日星期一開始，為期兩週，地點在山坡學校，不是像去年在運動中心。每天九點開始，四點結束。可以選足球、網球或籃球。費用每週四十五英鎊。請自備午餐，因為那裡沒有餐廳。也記得帶水壺，天氣會很熱。報名請打電話給迪克森老師，拼法是 D-I-X-O-N。
lines.en: Hi, everyone. I'm going to give you some information about the summer sports camp. The camp starts on Monday the third of August and lasts for two weeks. It's at Hillside School — not at the sports centre like last year. Every day starts at nine o'clock and finishes at four. You can choose from football, tennis and basketball. The cost is forty-five pounds a week. Please bring a packed lunch, because there's no café. And remember to bring a water bottle — it gets very hot. To book a place, phone Mr Dixon — that's D-I-X-O-N.

explain.zh: 「八月三日星期一開始」。
「在山坡學校」（Hillside），不是運動中心。
explain.en: Hillside School, not the sports centre.

explain.zh: 「每週四十五英鎊」。

ask.s: Bring: a packed lunch and a ＿＿＿＿＿
ask.en: Bring: a packed lunch and a ＿＿＿＿＿

explain.zh: 「也記得帶水壺」。
「迪克森老師，拼法是 D-I-X-O-N」。

lines.s: Hi Zoe. You weren't at school yesterday. Were you ill?
lines.zh: 嗨，柔伊。你昨天沒來學校，生病了嗎？
lines.en: Hi Zoe. You weren't at school yesterday. Were you ill?

lines.s: No, I was at a swimming competition in Manchester. I was there for two days.
lines.zh: 沒有，我去曼徹斯特參加游泳比賽，在那裡待了兩天。
lines.en: No, I was at a swimming competition in Manchester. I was there for two days.

lines.s: Wow! How did you do?
lines.zh: 哇！成績怎麼樣？
lines.en: Wow! How did you do?

lines.s: I came second in the hundred metres. I was a bit disappointed, because I came first last year.
lines.zh: 我一百公尺拿第二。有點失望，因為去年我是第一。
lines.en: I came second in the hundred metres. I was a bit disappointed, because I came first last year.

lines.s: Second is still great! How often do you train?
lines.zh: 第二名還是很棒啊！你多久練一次？
lines.en: Second is still great! How often do you train?

lines.s: Five mornings a week, before school. I get up at half past five.
lines.zh: 一週五個早上，上學前。我五點半起床。
lines.en: Five mornings a week, before school. I get up at half past five.

lines.s: That's so early! Do you have a coach?
lines.zh: 好早！你有教練嗎？
lines.en: That's so early! Do you have a coach?

lines.s: Yes, my coach is called Ruth. She swam for the national team when she was younger.
lines.zh: 有，我的教練叫露絲。她年輕的時候是國家隊的游泳選手。
lines.en: Yes, my coach is called Ruth. She swam for the national team when she was younger.

lines.s: What's next for you?
lines.zh: 接下來呢？
lines.en: What's next for you?

lines.s: There's a competition in London in June. I need to swim faster before then, so I'm going to train on Saturdays too.
lines.zh: 六月在倫敦有比賽。在那之前我要游得更快，所以星期六也要練習。
lines.en: There's a competition in London in June. I need to swim faster before then, so I'm going to train on Saturdays too.

ask.s: Why wasn't Zoe at school yesterday?
ask.zh: 柔伊昨天為什麼沒來學校？
ask.en: Why wasn't Zoe at school yesterday?

explain.zh: 「我去曼徹斯特參加游泳比賽」，不是生病。
explain.en: She was at a swimming competition.

ask.s: How did Zoe feel about her result?
ask.zh: 柔伊對成績有什麼感覺？
ask.en: How did Zoe feel about her result?

explain.zh: 拿第二，「有點失望」，因為去年是第一。
explain.en: A bit disappointed: she won last year.

explain.zh: 「一週五個早上，上學前」。
explain.en: Five mornings a week, before school.

ask.s: What do we learn about Ruth?
ask.zh: 關於露絲，我們知道什麼？
ask.en: What do we learn about Ruth?

options.t: She is in the national team now.
She used to be a swimmer.

explain.zh: 她「年輕的時候」是國家隊選手，現在是教練。
explain.en: She swam for the national team when younger.

ask.s: What will Zoe do before June?
ask.en: What will Zoe do before June?

explain.zh: 「星期六也要練習」：練更多。
explain.en: She will train on Saturdays too.

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about a film.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談一部電影。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about a film.

lines.s: Everyone said the film was funny, but I didn't laugh once. The music was good, though, and the actors were great.
lines.zh: 大家都說那部電影很好笑，可是我一次都沒笑。不過音樂很好聽，演員也很棒。
lines.en: Everyone said the film was funny, but I didn't laugh once. The music was good, though, and the actors were great.

ask.s: What did the girl like about the film?
ask.zh: 女孩喜歡這部電影的什麼？
ask.en: What did the girl like about the film?

explain.zh: 她「一次都沒笑」，但「音樂很好聽」。
explain.en: She didn't laugh, but the music was good.

lines.s: You will hear a man phoning a shop.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士打電話到商店。
lines.en: You will hear a man phoning a shop.

lines.s: Hello, I bought a lamp from you yesterday, but it doesn't work. Can I bring it back and get my money back, please?
lines.zh: 你好，我昨天在你們店裡買了一盞檯燈，可是不會亮。我可以拿回去退錢嗎？
lines.en: Hello, I bought a lamp from you yesterday, but it doesn't work. Can I bring it back and get my money back, please?

explain.zh: 「拿回去退錢」。

lines.s: You will hear a teacher talking to her class.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位老師對班上說話。
lines.en: You will hear a teacher talking to her class.

lines.s: Tomorrow we're going to the theatre, so there's no maths lesson. Please be at the front gate at ten. Don't bring any food — we'll have lunch at school when we get back.
lines.zh: 明天我們要去劇院，所以沒有數學課。請十點在學校大門集合。不要帶食物，回來後在學校吃午餐。
lines.en: Tomorrow we're going to the theatre, so there's no maths lesson. Please be at the front gate at ten. Don't bring any food — we'll have lunch at school when we get back.

ask.s: Where should the students meet tomorrow?
ask.zh: 學生明天要在哪裡集合？
ask.en: Where should the students meet tomorrow?

explain.zh: 「十點在學校大門集合」。
explain.en: At the front gate at ten.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a present.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一份禮物。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a present.

lines.s: Shall we buy Lisa a book for her birthday?
lines.zh: 我們買一本書送麗莎當生日禮物好嗎？
lines.en: Shall we buy Lisa a book for her birthday?

lines.s: She's got hundreds! She said she wants a plant for her room.
lines.zh: 她的書有好幾百本了！她說想要一盆植物放房間。
lines.en: She's got hundreds! She said she wants a plant for her room.

lines.s: OK, let's get her that.
lines.zh: 好，那就買那個。
lines.en: OK, let's get her that.

explain.zh: 書太多了，她「想要一盆植物」，他們就買那個。
explain.en: She has hundreds of books; she wants a plant.

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩談他的週末。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.

lines.s: I was going to play football on Saturday, but it rained all day. So I stayed at home and made a cake with my brother. It was delicious!
lines.zh: 我星期六本來要踢足球，可是下了一整天雨。所以我待在家，和弟弟一起做蛋糕，很好吃！
lines.en: I was going to play football on Saturday, but it rained all day. So I stayed at home and made a cake with my brother. It was delicious!

ask.s: What did the boy do on Saturday?
ask.en: What did the boy do on Saturday?

explain.zh: 下雨沒踢球，「和弟弟一起做蛋糕」。
explain.en: Rain stopped football; he made a cake.

lines.s: Have you got everyone's jobs for the school fair, Mr Ross?
lines.zh: 羅斯老師，園遊會每個人的工作都排好了嗎？
lines.en: Have you got everyone's jobs for the school fair, Mr Ross?

lines.s: Nearly. Amir is going to sell plants — his dad has a garden centre.
lines.zh: 快好了。阿米爾要賣植物，他爸爸開園藝店。
lines.en: Nearly. Amir is going to sell plants — his dad has a garden centre.

lines.s: Great. And Becky? She's good at art.
lines.zh: 太好了。那貝琪呢？她很會畫畫。
lines.en: Great. And Becky? She's good at art.

lines.s: I asked her to do the face painting, but she wants to make cakes with her mum, so she's doing that.
lines.zh: 我請她負責臉部彩繪，可是她想和媽媽一起做蛋糕，所以就讓她做蛋糕。
lines.en: I asked her to do the face painting, but she wants to make cakes with her mum, so she's doing that.

lines.s: OK. Who's selling tickets at the door?
lines.zh: 好。誰在門口賣票？
lines.en: OK. Who's selling tickets at the door?

lines.s: Callum. He's very good with numbers.
lines.zh: 卡倫，他算數很好。
lines.en: Callum. He's very good with numbers.

lines.s: What about Daisy? She brought her music speakers last year.
lines.zh: 黛西呢？她去年帶了音響來。
lines.en: What about Daisy? She brought her music speakers last year.

lines.s: This year she's organising games for the little children. Ethan's going to play music instead.
lines.zh: 今年她負責帶小朋友玩遊戲。改由伊森放音樂。
lines.en: This year she's organising games for the little children. Ethan's going to play music instead.

lines.s: And who's taking photos?
lines.zh: 那誰拍照？
lines.en: And who's taking photos?

lines.s: I'll do that myself.
lines.zh: 我自己來。
lines.en: I'll do that myself.

explain.zh: 「阿米爾要賣植物」。
本來請她做臉部彩繪，但她「想和媽媽一起做蛋糕」。
在門口賣票的是卡倫。
黛西「今年負責帶小朋友玩遊戲」；音樂是伊森。
explain.en: Daisy organises games; Ethan does music.

explain.zh: 「改由伊森放音樂」。

panels: a plain T-shirt
a pair of trainers
a sun hat
a big museum building with columns; no writing, no numbers anywhere
an outdoor market with fruit stalls; no writing, no numbers anywhere
a restaurant table by a river with plates and glasses
a round cake
a plate of biscuits
a bowl of ice cream
a girl holding a game controller in front of a screen
a girl reading a book on a sofa
a girl painting at an easel
a tent next to a lake
a hotel building; no writing, no numbers anywhere
a caravan parked among trees

lines.s: Did you buy anything in town?
lines.zh: 你在市區有買東西嗎？
lines.en: Did you buy anything in town?

lines.s: I looked at some shoes, but they didn't have my size. I didn't need a hat, so I just got a T-shirt.
lines.zh: 我看了幾雙鞋，可是沒有我的尺寸。我不需要帽子，所以只買了一件 T 恤。
lines.en: I looked at some shoes, but they didn't have my size. I didn't need a hat, so I just got a T-shirt.

q.s: What did the boy buy?
q.en: What did the boy buy?

explain.zh: 鞋子沒尺寸、不需要帽子，「只買了一件 T 恤」。
explain.en: No shoes in his size, no need for a hat: a T-shirt.

lines.s: Where are you meeting your cousins tomorrow? At the museum?
lines.zh: 你明天在哪裡跟表兄弟姊妹見面？博物館嗎？
lines.en: Where are you meeting your cousins tomorrow? At the museum?

lines.s: We were going to, but it's closed on Mondays. We'll meet at the restaurant by the river, and then maybe go to the market.
lines.zh: 本來是，可是博物館星期一休館。我們會在河邊的餐廳見面，之後也許去市集。
lines.en: We were going to, but it's closed on Mondays. We'll meet at the restaurant by the river, and then maybe go to the market.

q.s: Where will the girl meet her cousins?
q.zh: 女孩會在哪裡和表兄弟姊妹見面？
q.en: Where will the girl meet her cousins?

explain.zh: 博物館休館，「在河邊的餐廳見面」；市集是之後。
explain.en: The museum is closed; they meet at the restaurant.

lines.s: Shall I make a cake for the class party?
lines.zh: 我要不要為班上的派對做一個蛋糕？
lines.en: Shall I make a cake for the class party?

lines.s: Someone's already bringing one. And ice cream would melt. Can you make some biscuits?
lines.zh: 已經有人要帶了。冰淇淋又會融化。你可以做一些餅乾嗎？
lines.en: Someone's already bringing one. And ice cream would melt. Can you make some biscuits?

lines.s: OK, no problem.
lines.zh: 好，沒問題。
lines.en: OK, no problem.

q.s: What will the girl make?
q.en: What will the girl make?

explain.zh: 蛋糕已經有人帶、冰淇淋會融化，她答應做「餅乾」。
explain.en: A cake is coming, ice cream would melt: biscuits.

lines.s: What do you do when you get home from school?
lines.zh: 你放學回家後做什麼？
lines.en: What do you do when you get home from school?

lines.s: My brother plays computer games, but I always read for an hour. I paint at the weekend.
lines.zh: 我弟弟打電動，但我都會看一小時的書。畫畫是週末。
lines.en: My brother plays computer games, but I always read for an hour. I paint at the weekend.

q.s: What does the girl do after school?
q.en: What does the girl do after school?

explain.zh: 「我都會看一小時的書」；打電動的是弟弟，畫畫是週末。
explain.en: She reads; her brother plays games; she paints at weekends.

lines.s: Are you staying in a hotel on holiday?
lines.zh: 你們度假住飯店嗎？
lines.en: Are you staying in a hotel on holiday?

lines.s: No, they're too expensive. We wanted to go camping, but Mum hates tents, so we've rented a caravan.
lines.zh: 不是，飯店太貴了。我們本來想露營，可是媽媽討厭帳篷，所以租了一台露營車。
lines.en: No, they're too expensive. We wanted to go camping, but Mum hates tents, so we've rented a caravan.

q.s: Where will the family stay?
q.en: Where will the family stay?

explain.zh: 飯店太貴、媽媽討厭帳篷，「租了一台露營車」。
explain.en: Hotels too expensive, Mum hates tents: a caravan.

lines.s: Hello and welcome to Riverside Art Club. Let me tell you how the club works. We meet every Wednesday, from half past four until six, in Room 8. Each week we try something different — this month it's painting animals. The club costs two pounds each week, and you pay at the start of each lesson. We give you paper and paints, but please bring an old shirt to wear, because it can get messy. At the end of term we're having an exhibition in the town library. If you need to talk to me, my name's Miss Hart — H-A-R-T.
lines.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到河畔美術社。我來說明社團怎麼進行。我們每個星期三四點半到六點在 8 號教室聚會。每週嘗試不同的東西，這個月是畫動物。社費每週兩英鎊，每堂課開始時付。我們提供紙和顏料，但請帶一件舊襯衫來穿，因為會弄髒。學期末我們會在鎮立圖書館辦展覽。有事要找我的話，我是哈特老師，拼法是 H-A-R-T。
lines.en: Hello and welcome to Riverside Art Club. Let me tell you how the club works. We meet every Wednesday, from half past four until six, in Room 8. Each week we try something different — this month it's painting animals. The club costs two pounds each week, and you pay at the start of each lesson. We give you paper and paints, but please bring an old shirt to wear, because it can get messy. At the end of term we're having an exhibition in the town library. If you need to talk to me, my name's Miss Hart — H-A-R-T.

explain.zh: 「每個星期三」。
「四點半到六點」：六點結束。
「社費每週兩英鎊」。
「請帶一件舊襯衫來穿」；紙和顏料社團提供。
explain.en: An old shirt; paper and paints are given.

explain.zh: 「在鎮立圖書館辦展覽」。

lines.s: Hi Grace! How was your trip to Paris?
lines.zh: 嗨，葛蕾絲！巴黎之旅怎麼樣？
lines.en: Hi Grace! How was your trip to Paris?

lines.s: Amazing, thanks. We went for five days with my school.
lines.zh: 超棒的，謝謝。我們跟學校去了五天。
lines.en: Amazing, thanks. We went for five days with my school.

lines.s: Did you go up the Eiffel Tower?
lines.zh: 你們有上艾菲爾鐵塔嗎？
lines.en: Did you go up the Eiffel Tower?

lines.s: We wanted to, but the queue was really long, so we went on a boat on the river instead. You can see the tower from the boat too.
lines.zh: 本來想去，可是排隊的人超多，所以改去河上搭船。從船上也看得到鐵塔。
lines.en: We wanted to, but the queue was really long, so we went on a boat on the river instead. You can see the tower from the boat too.

lines.s: What was the food like?
lines.zh: 食物怎麼樣？
lines.en: What was the food like?

lines.s: Lovely. The bread was the best thing — I ate it every day! I didn't like the cheese much, though.
lines.zh: 很好吃。麵包最棒，我每天都吃！不過起司我不太喜歡。
lines.en: Lovely. The bread was the best thing — I ate it every day! I didn't like the cheese much, though.

lines.s: Did you speak French?
lines.zh: 你有說法文嗎？
lines.en: Did you speak French?

lines.s: A little. I ordered food in French, and the waiters understood me. I was really pleased.
lines.zh: 說了一點。我用法文點餐，服務生聽得懂，我很開心。
lines.en: A little. I ordered food in French, and the waiters understood me. I was really pleased.

lines.s: Would you go back?
lines.zh: 你會想再去嗎？
lines.en: Would you go back?

lines.s: Definitely. My mum says we can go together next year for her birthday.
lines.zh: 當然。我媽說明年她生日時我們可以一起去。
lines.en: Definitely. My mum says we can go together next year for her birthday.

ask.s: Who did Grace go to Paris with?
ask.en: Who did Grace go to Paris with?

explain.zh: 「我們跟學校去了五天」。

ask.s: Why didn't they go up the Eiffel Tower?
ask.zh: 他們為什麼沒上艾菲爾鐵塔？
ask.en: Why didn't they go up the Eiffel Tower?

options.t: There were too many people waiting.

explain.zh: 「排隊的人超多」。

ask.s: What food did Grace like best?
ask.zh: 葛蕾絲最喜歡什麼食物？
ask.en: What food did Grace like best?

explain.zh: 「麵包最棒」；起司她不太喜歡。
explain.en: The bread; she didn't like the cheese.

ask.s: How did Grace feel about speaking French?
ask.zh: 葛蕾絲說法文的感覺如何？
ask.en: How did Grace feel about speaking French?

explain.zh: 服務生聽得懂，「我很開心」。

ask.s: When might Grace go back to Paris?
ask.zh: 葛蕾絲可能什麼時候再去巴黎？
ask.en: When might Grace go back to Paris?

explain.zh: 「明年她生日時我們可以一起去」。
explain.en: Next year, for her mum's birthday.

lines.s: You will hear a woman talking about her new neighbour.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士談她的新鄰居。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking about her new neighbour.

lines.s: My new neighbour is very nice, but he plays the drums every evening! I've asked him to stop at nine o'clock, and he's agreed.
lines.zh: 我的新鄰居人很好，可是他每天晚上都打鼓！我請他九點以後別打了，他答應了。
lines.en: My new neighbour is very nice, but he plays the drums every evening! I've asked him to stop at nine o'clock, and he's agreed.

ask.s: What does the woman say about her neighbour?
ask.en: What does the woman say about her neighbour?

options.t: He makes a lot of noise.

explain.zh: 他人很好，但「每天晚上都打鼓」：很吵。
explain.en: Nice, but he plays the drums every evening.

lines.s: You will hear a boy asking about a bus.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩問公車的事。
lines.en: You will hear a boy asking about a bus.

lines.s: Excuse me, does this bus go to the stadium?
lines.zh: 請問這班公車有到體育場嗎？
lines.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the stadium?

lines.s: No, you need the number twelve. It stops over there, opposite the bank.
lines.zh: 沒有，你要搭 12 號。它停在那邊，銀行對面。
lines.en: No, you need the number twelve. It stops over there, opposite the bank.

explain.zh: 12 號公車「停在銀行對面」。
explain.en: The number 12 stops opposite the bank.

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about a book.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談一本書。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about a book.

lines.s: The book has six hundred pages, so I thought it would take me months. But it was so exciting that I finished it in a week.
lines.zh: 那本書有六百頁，我以為要看好幾個月。可是太精彩了，我一個星期就看完了。
lines.en: The book has six hundred pages, so I thought it would take me months. But it was so exciting that I finished it in a week.

ask.s: How long did it take the girl to read the book?
ask.zh: 女孩花了多久看完這本書？
ask.en: How long did it take the girl to read the book?

explain.zh: 「我一個星期就看完了」；好幾個月只是她原本以為的。
explain.en: A week; months was only what she expected.

lines.s: You will hear a man talking about a sports centre.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士談一間運動中心。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about a sports centre.

lines.s: The new sports centre has a great pool and a gym, but the café is terrible. The sandwiches are old and the coffee is cold.
lines.zh: 新的運動中心有很棒的游泳池和健身房，可是餐廳很糟。三明治不新鮮，咖啡是冷的。
lines.en: The new sports centre has a great pool and a gym, but the café is terrible. The sandwiches are old and the coffee is cold.

explain.zh: 「餐廳很糟」；游泳池和健身房他覺得很棒。
explain.en: The café is terrible; the pool and gym are great.

lines.s: You will hear a mother talking to her daughter.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位媽媽對女兒說話。
lines.en: You will hear a mother talking to her daughter.

lines.s: Your room is a mess, Kate! Before your friends come, please put your clothes away. You can do your homework later.
lines.zh: 凱特，你的房間好亂！朋友來之前，請把衣服收好。功課可以晚點再寫。
lines.en: Your room is a mess, Kate! Before your friends come, please put your clothes away. You can do your homework later.

ask.s: What does the mother want Kate to do?
ask.en: What does the mother want Kate to do?

explain.zh: 「朋友來之前，請把衣服收好」；功課晚點寫。
explain.en: Put her clothes away first; homework later.

lines.s: So, what did you bring back from Scotland for everyone?
lines.zh: 那你從蘇格蘭帶了什麼回來給大家？
lines.en: So, what did you bring back from Scotland for everyone?

lines.s: For Mum, I wanted to get a scarf, but she's got lots, so I bought her a mug with a picture of a castle.
lines.zh: 給媽媽的，本來想買圍巾，可是她已經很多了，所以買了一個印著城堡的馬克杯。
lines.en: For Mum, I wanted to get a scarf, but she's got lots, so I bought her a mug with a picture of a castle.

lines.s: She'll love that. What about Grandpa?
lines.zh: 她會很喜歡。爺爺呢？
lines.en: She'll love that. What about Grandpa?

lines.s: He's always cold, so I got him some warm socks.
lines.zh: 他總是很怕冷，所以我買了保暖的襪子。
lines.en: He's always cold, so I got him some warm socks.

lines.s: Good idea. And Uncle Joe?
lines.zh: 好主意。喬叔叔呢？
lines.en: Good idea. And Uncle Joe?

lines.s: He likes sweet things, so chocolates. I nearly got him a game, but he never plays games.
lines.zh: 他喜歡甜的，所以買巧克力。本來差點買桌遊，可是他從來不玩。
lines.en: He likes sweet things, so chocolates. I nearly got him a game, but he never plays games.

lines.s: And Aunt Sue?
lines.zh: 蘇阿姨呢？
lines.en: And Aunt Sue?

lines.s: A little plant for her kitchen. And for Tim, a jumper with a sheep on it — he'll think it's funny.
lines.zh: 一盆放廚房的小植物。給提姆的是一件有綿羊圖案的毛衣，他一定覺得很好笑。
lines.en: A little plant for her kitchen. And for Tim, a jumper with a sheep on it — he'll think it's funny.

lines.s: And nothing for me?
lines.zh: 那我沒有嗎？
lines.en: And nothing for me?

lines.s: Of course there's something for you, Dad — but it's a surprise!
lines.zh: 當然有你的，爸，不過是驚喜！
lines.en: Of course there's something for you, Dad — but it's a surprise!

explain.zh: 圍巾她很多了，所以「買了一個印著城堡的馬克杯」。
他怕冷，「買了保暖的襪子」。
喜歡甜的，「所以買巧克力」；桌遊他不玩。
「一盆放廚房的小植物」。
「一件有綿羊圖案的毛衣」。
explain.en: A jumper with a sheep on it.

panels: a black umbrella
a woolly hat
a pair of sunglasses
a bus at a bus stop; no writing, no numbers anywhere
a train at a station platform; no writing, no numbers anywhere
a ferry boat on the sea
a boy playing chess
a boy playing a computer game
a boy playing table tennis
a birthday cake with candles
a box of chocolates
a bunch of flowers
a woman in a dentist's chair
a woman at a hairdresser's
a woman at a doctor's desk

lines.s: It's going to rain this afternoon. Have you got your umbrella?
lines.zh: 今天下午會下雨，你帶傘了嗎？
lines.en: It's going to rain this afternoon. Have you got your umbrella?

lines.s: I forgot it! I've only got my hat and sunglasses. I'll buy one at the station.
lines.zh: 我忘了！我只帶了帽子和太陽眼鏡。我去車站買一把。
lines.en: I forgot it! I've only got my hat and sunglasses. I'll buy one at the station.

q.s: What does the man need to buy?
q.en: What does the man need to buy?

explain.zh: 他忘了帶傘，要去車站「買一把」。

lines.s: How are you getting to the island?
lines.zh: 妳要怎麼去那座島？
lines.en: How are you getting to the island?

lines.s: There's no bridge, so I can't take the bus or the train. I'm going by boat.
lines.zh: 那裡沒有橋，所以不能搭公車或火車。我搭船去。
lines.en: There's no bridge, so I can't take the bus or the train. I'm going by boat.

q.s: How is the woman travelling?
q.en: How is the woman travelling?

explain.zh: 「我搭船去」。

lines.s: Does your son still play table tennis?
lines.zh: 你兒子還在打桌球嗎？
lines.en: Does your son still play table tennis?

lines.s: No, now he's in the chess club at school. He says it's better than computer games!
lines.zh: 沒有，他現在參加學校的西洋棋社。他說比電腦遊戲好玩！
lines.en: No, now he's in the chess club at school. He says it's better than computer games!

q.s: What does the man's son do now?
q.en: What does the man's son do now?

explain.zh: 「他現在參加……西洋棋社」。

lines.s: What shall we take to Grandma's? Some flowers?
lines.zh: 我們帶什麼去奶奶家？花嗎？
lines.en: What shall we take to Grandma's? Some flowers?

lines.s: She's got lots in her garden. Let's take chocolates — she loves them. Mum is making a cake.
lines.zh: 她花園裡很多花。帶巧克力吧，她最愛了。媽媽在做蛋糕。
lines.en: She's got lots in her garden. Let's take chocolates — she loves them. Mum is making a cake.

q.s: What will they take to Grandma?
q.en: What will they take to Grandma?

explain.zh: 「帶巧克力吧」；蛋糕是媽媽做的。

lines.s: I can't meet you at four. I've got an appointment.
lines.zh: 我四點不能跟你見面，我有約。
lines.en: I can't meet you at four. I've got an appointment.

lines.s: At the doctor's?
lines.zh: 看醫生嗎？
lines.en: At the doctor's?

lines.s: No, I'm fine! I'm having my hair cut.
lines.zh: 不是，我很好！我要去剪頭髮。
lines.en: No, I'm fine! I'm having my hair cut.

q.s: Where is the woman going at four?
q.en: Where is the woman going at four?

explain.zh: 「我要去剪頭髮」。

lines.s: Good morning. Here is some information about the town's summer festival. It takes place on Saturday the twelfth of July in River Park. It starts at eleven in the morning. There will be music, food and a dance competition. Tickets cost eight pounds for adults, and children go free. Please don't bring your car — you can take the free bus from the train station. For more information, look at our website: Benfield festival dot com. That's B-E-N-F-I-E-L-D.
lines.zh: 早安。以下是本鎮夏日節慶的資訊。活動在七月十二日星期六於河濱公園舉行，早上十一點開始。會有音樂、美食和舞蹈比賽。成人票八英鎊，兒童免費。請不要開車，可以從火車站搭免費巴士。更多資訊請上網站：Benfield festival dot com，拼法是 B-E-N-F-I-E-L-D。
lines.en: Good morning. Here is some information about the town's summer festival. It takes place on Saturday the twelfth of July in River Park. It starts at eleven in the morning. There will be music, food and a dance competition. Tickets cost eight pounds for adults, and children go free. Please don't bring your car — you can take the free bus from the train station. For more information, look at our website: Benfield festival dot com. That's B-E-N-F-I-E-L-D.

explain.zh: 「七月十二日星期六」。
「在河濱公園」。
「成人票八英鎊」。
「從火車站搭免費巴士」。
「B-E-N-F-I-E-L-D」。

lines.s: You will hear Paul talking to his friend Sophie about a holiday.
lines.zh: 你會聽到保羅和朋友蘇菲談一次假期。
lines.en: You will hear Paul talking to his friend Sophie about a holiday.

lines.s: Hi Sophie. How was your holiday in Scotland?
lines.zh: 嗨，蘇菲，蘇格蘭的假期怎麼樣？
lines.en: Hi Sophie. How was your holiday in Scotland?

lines.s: Great, thanks! We stayed in a small cottage by a lake for ten days.
lines.zh: 很棒，謝謝！我們在湖邊一間小屋住了十天。
lines.en: Great, thanks! We stayed in a small cottage by a lake for ten days.

lines.s: Was the weather good?
lines.zh: 天氣好嗎？
lines.en: Was the weather good?

lines.s: It rained a lot in the first week, but the last three days were sunny. We went walking in the mountains then.
lines.zh: 第一週常下雨，但最後三天天氣晴朗，我們就去山上健行。
lines.en: It rained a lot in the first week, but the last three days were sunny. We went walking in the mountains then.

lines.s: Did you do anything else?
lines.zh: 還做了什麼？
lines.en: Did you do anything else?

lines.s: We hired a boat on the lake. My brother wanted to go fishing, but he didn't catch anything!
lines.zh: 我們在湖上租了船。我哥想釣魚，可是什麼都沒釣到！
lines.en: We hired a boat on the lake. My brother wanted to go fishing, but he didn't catch anything!

lines.s: What was the food like?
lines.zh: 食物怎麼樣？
lines.en: What was the food like?

lines.s: We cooked most meals ourselves, but on the last night we had dinner at a hotel. That was the best meal of the holiday.
lines.zh: 大部分我們自己煮，最後一晚在一家旅館吃晚餐，那是整趟假期最好的一餐。
lines.en: We cooked most meals ourselves, but on the last night we had dinner at a hotel. That was the best meal of the holiday.

explain.zh: 「在湖邊一間小屋住了十天」。
「住了十天」。

options.t: at the end of the holiday

explain.zh: 最後三天晴朗，「我們就去山上健行」。

ask.s: What happened when Sophie's brother went fishing?
ask.zh: 蘇菲的哥哥釣魚結果怎樣？
ask.en: What happened when Sophie's brother went fishing?

explain.zh: 「什麼都沒釣到」。

ask.s: Where did Sophie have her favourite meal?
ask.zh: 蘇菲最喜歡的一餐在哪裡吃？
ask.en: Where did Sophie have her favourite meal?

explain.zh: 「最後一晚在一家旅館吃晚餐，那是……最好的一餐」。

lines.s: You will hear a woman talking about her new job.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士談她的新工作。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking about her new job.

lines.s: I really like my new job. The work is interesting and my colleagues are kind, but it takes me an hour to get there.
lines.zh: 我很喜歡新工作。工作有趣、同事友善，但通勤要一個小時。
lines.en: I really like my new job. The work is interesting and my colleagues are kind, but it takes me an hour to get there.

ask.s: What doesn't the woman like about her job?
ask.zh: 女士不喜歡新工作的什麼？
ask.en: What doesn't the woman like about her job?

explain.zh: 「通勤要一個小時」。

lines.s: You will hear a man in a clothes shop.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士在服飾店。
lines.en: You will hear a man in a clothes shop.

lines.s: This jacket is too small. Have you got it in a large? Oh, and in blue, not black, please.
lines.zh: 這件外套太小了，有 L 號嗎？喔，請給我藍色，不要黑色。
lines.en: This jacket is too small. Have you got it in a large? Oh, and in blue, not black, please.

explain.zh: 要「L 號」和「藍色」。

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking to her father.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩和爸爸說話。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking to her father.

lines.s: Dad, can you pick me up at five instead of four? We've got an extra basketball practice today.
lines.zh: 爸，你可以五點來接我，不是四點嗎？今天籃球多一次練習。
lines.en: Dad, can you pick me up at five instead of four? We've got an extra basketball practice today.

ask.s: Why will the girl finish late?
ask.en: Why will the girl finish late?

explain.zh: 「籃球多一次練習」。

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a film.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一部電影。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a film.

lines.s: Did you enjoy the film?
lines.zh: 妳喜歡那部電影嗎？
lines.en: Did you enjoy the film?

lines.s: The story was a bit silly, but the actors were brilliant. I'd see it again just for them.
lines.zh: 故事有點蠢，但演員超棒。光為了他們我就願意再看一次。
lines.en: The story was a bit silly, but the actors were brilliant. I'd see it again just for them.

ask.s: What did the girl like about the film?
ask.en: What did the girl like about the film?

explain.zh: 「演員超棒」。

lines.s: You will hear a teacher talking to a class.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位老師對班上說話。
lines.en: You will hear a teacher talking to a class.

lines.s: Your homework this week is to read chapter four. You don't need to write anything — we'll discuss it on Friday.
lines.zh: 這週的作業是讀第四章，不用寫任何東西，我們星期五討論。
lines.en: Your homework this week is to read chapter four. You don't need to write anything — we'll discuss it on Friday.

explain.zh: 「讀第四章」。

lines.s: You will hear Kate talking to her dad about her class party. What will each person do?
lines.zh: 你會聽到凱特和爸爸談班上的派對。每個人負責什麼？
lines.en: You will hear Kate talking to her dad about her class party. What will each person do?

lines.s: So, who's doing what for your class party, Kate?
lines.zh: 凱特，班上派對誰負責什麼？
lines.en: So, who's doing what for your class party, Kate?

lines.s: Well, Liam is going to do the music — he's got great speakers.
lines.zh: 嗯，連恩負責音樂，他有很棒的音響。
lines.en: Well, Liam is going to do the music — he's got great speakers.

lines.s: And Olivia? She loves cooking, doesn't she?
lines.zh: 奧莉維亞呢？她不是很愛做菜嗎？
lines.en: And Olivia? She loves cooking, doesn't she?

lines.s: She does, but her mum's doing the food. Olivia is making the invitations on her computer.
lines.zh: 是啊，但食物由她媽媽做。奧莉維亞用電腦做邀請卡。
lines.en: She does, but her mum's doing the food. Olivia is making the invitations on her computer.

lines.s: What about Noah?
lines.zh: 諾亞呢？
lines.en: What about Noah?

lines.s: He's going to the supermarket to buy everything we need.
lines.zh: 他去超市買我們需要的東西。
lines.en: He's going to the supermarket to buy everything we need.

lines.s: And Grace?
lines.zh: 葛蕾絲呢？
lines.en: And Grace?

lines.s: She wanted to take photos, but her camera's broken, so she's organising some games instead.
lines.zh: 她本來想拍照，可是相機壞了，所以改成負責遊戲。
lines.en: She wanted to take photos, but her camera's broken, so she's organising some games instead.

lines.s: And what about you?
lines.zh: 那妳呢？
lines.en: And what about you?

lines.s: I'm doing the decorations with balloons and lights!
lines.zh: 我負責用氣球和燈泡布置！
lines.en: I'm doing the decorations with balloons and lights!

explain.zh: 「連恩負責音樂」。
食物是她媽媽做的，她「用電腦做邀請卡」。
「去超市買……東西」。
相機壞了，「改成負責遊戲」。
「我負責……布置」。
